sql: SELECT co.name AS empresa, c.bot_paused_reason AS motivo, count(*) AS conversas, sum(CASE WHEN c.remote_jid LIKE '5511996472316%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nauber, to_char(min(c.bot_paused_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS primeira, to_char(max(c.bot_paused_at) AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI') AS ultima FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = w.company_id WHERE c.bot_paused_reason LIKE 'loop_%' AND c.bot_paused_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
